name: AI Receptionist: Chat & Booking | Owlixi
author: Owlixi

sections.description:
Owlixi adds a 24/7 AI receptionist to your WordPress site and business phone line. It answers calls, chats with visitors, answers service and pricing questions, and schedules appointments directly into your calendar.

Train it in minutes using your site pages, menus, price lists, or voice notes. Owlixi works day and night so you never miss a client or a booking opportunity.

🎁 3-Day Free Trial

Test the AI phone line with zero risk:
* 3 days of full access to the AI Receptionist
* 15 minutes of live talk time with real callers
* 1 dedicated local business number (US, UK, Canada, EU)

💼 Plans

  • Starter (Free forever): Unlimited website AI chat, smart booking terminal, site training.
  • Pro: Instant training updates, WhatsApp & Telegram alerts, conversation logs.
  • AI Reception Lite: 1 business number, 40 phone calls/mo, call forwarding.
  • AI Reception Pro: 1 business number, 100 calls/mo, live operator transfer, Calendly sync, web calls.
  • AI Reception Ultra: 1 business number, unlimited calls, 24/7 VIP onboarding.

🎙️ AI Reception (Phone & Browser Web Calls)

  • Business Phone Numbers: Get local business numbers from USA, Canada, UK and European countries. Professional phone presence available 24/7.
  • Browser Web Calls: Customers can call your AI receptionist directly from your website using browser microphones — no phone fees, no phone numbers required, works in any country.
  • AI Call Handoff: Callers can request a live person anytime; the AI seamlessly connects them to the right team member.
  • Smart Voice Bookings: Handles new appointments, edits, cancellations, and rescheduling — all naturally by voice.
  • Identity & Voice Tuning: Customize voice model, tone, speaking pace, custom greetings, and auto-locality detection.
  • AI Control & Knowledge: View call recordings and AI summaries in WordPress or messengers. Train the AI anytime with menus, prices, and files.

📅 Smart Booking System

  • AI Chat & Phone Bookings: Conversational bookings, edits, and cancellations with zero staff required. Time slots update instantly.
  • Easy Booking Integrations: Use the built-in Owlixi Booking Terminal or connect your Calendly schedule.
  • Instant Multi-Channel Alerts: Real-time notifications via WhatsApp, Telegram, Email, or SMS for every new booking or change.
  • Staff Booking Terminal: Share access with your staff to manage schedules, view upcoming bookings, and stay in sync on any device.
  • Mobile Friendly & Flexible: Customers book seamlessly from any smartphone; customize business hours, services, buffers, and booking rules.

💬 Smart AI Chatbot

  • Answers Customers 24/7: Provides instant, accurate answers from your website, menus, prices, documents, and FAQs.
  • Learns Your Business: Automatically trains on your website content in minutes, keeping company information up to date.
  • Multilingual & Natural: Chats fluently in multiple languages with auto-detection and a human-like, friendly tone.
  • Built-in In-Chat Booking: Customers check availability, book, or cancel directly inside the chat window.
  • Captures More Leads: Context-aware lead qualification captures contact details day and night.
  • Full Chat Customization: Tailor chat colors, position (left/right), icon, welcome greetings, and interactive quick action buttons.

🚀 Marketing & Lead Tools

  • Custom Form Builder: Create custom forms for inquiries, feedback, registrations, or quotes with custom styling and fields.
  • Targeted Pop-Up Campaigns: Display timed promotions, lead gen popups, and announcements linked to pages or offers.
  • Booking Preview Modal: High-converting, interactive booking modal preview right on your pages.
  • Targeted Display Rules: Control who sees popups and forms (all visitors, returning users, specific URLs) with timing triggers.
  • Instant Leads to Messengers: Lead submissions delivered immediately via Email, WhatsApp, Telegram, or CRM.

📊 Receptionist Analytics & Audio Insights

  • Daily & Weekly Reports: Receive automated activity digests, booking counts, and lead metrics delivered straight to your messenger.
  • Call & Chat Transcripts: Review visitor chat transcripts, listen to call recordings, and read AI-generated conversation summaries inside WordPress.
  • Actionable Customer Insights: Understand what questions visitors ask most frequently and identify opportunities to improve your services.

🌍 9 Built-in Languages

Your AI receptionist speaks your clients’ native languages fluently. The WordPress plugin interface, widget, and staff notifications are fully localized in:
* English (US, UK, CA, AU, NZ)
* German (DE, AT, CH, LI, LU)
* French (FR, BE, CH, CA, LU)
* Spanish (ES, MX, AR, CO, CL, PE)
* Italian (IT, CH, SM)
* Polish (PL, UK, DE, IE)
* Russian (RU, KZ, BY, LV, EE)
* Ukrainian (UA, PL, CA)
* Chinese (TW, HK, MO, CN, SG)

🔒 External Services & Privacy

This plugin connects to the Owlixi cloud service to deliver its AI chat and booking features.

Data sent to the service includes your site URL, site token, administrator email, and visitor chat/booking messages. Data transmission only occurs after the administrator explicitly enables consent in the plugin settings and clicks “Connect Owlixi”.

You retain full control and can request complete data deletion at any time by disconnecting the plugin or contacting our support team.

Terms of use: Terms of Use
Pricing: Pricing
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugins screen, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the Owlixi menu in WordPress Admin.
  4. Enable External Services consent and save settings.
  5. Click Connect Owlixi to create or link your account.
  6. Enable the chat widget.
sections.faq:
What does an AI Receptionist do?

An AI Receptionist acts as your automated digital front-desk on your website and phone line. It welcomes visitors, answers phone calls, answers questions about your services, pricing, and operating hours, captures leads, and books appointments 24/7 without needing human intervention.

Is there a free trial for the AI Receptionist phone line?

Yes! You can test the AI Receptionist Line with a 3-day free trial that includes 15 minutes of live talk time and 1 dedicated business phone number. No commitments or credit card required to explore.

What is included in the free Starter plan?

The Starter plan is completely free forever. It includes unlimited AI chatbot conversations on your website, access to the smart booking terminal, automated website parsing, custom scripts, and email notifications. Voice phone lines are available on our AI Reception plans.

How do I train my AI Receptionist?

Setup takes only a few minutes. Owlixi can automatically scan your published WordPress pages. You can also upload PDF price lists, service menus, Word documents, or send voice notes directly to your bot via WhatsApp or Telegram.

Can the AI Receptionist alert my staff about bookings and urgent inquiries?

Yes. When a client books an appointment or asks to speak with a team member, Owlixi sends instant notifications to your WhatsApp or Telegram with the customer’s contact details.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The AI widget can process your WooCommerce catalog, answer product questions, and assist customers during their shopping journey.

Does the plugin send data before consent?

No. External services remain strictly disabled until an administrator explicitly enables consent and connects the site.
